task: Add a source-controlled minimal Blank Studio system template for Builder selection, with canonical 14-page operational documents and neutral editable design tokens. Keep it outside the curated 42-template portfolio count and reuse all existing page/runtime/install authorities.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Blank Studio becomes a selectable system template and therefore must prove full Page Schema, installation, route, responsive and commerce-shell integrity. Strong behavioral proof is justified; formal verification is not because it reuses existing runtime, persistence and commerce authorities.

deferredTechniques.reason: No new state machine is introduced; installation and runtime state remain existing authorities.
No new transactional or concurrent protocol is introduced.

acceptanceCriteria: Blank Studio is a separately identified system template and does not increment the curated 42-template launch portfolio count.
Blank Studio is selectable from the same template library and resolvable by the same canonical template installation/preview paths.
The package contains exactly the canonical 14 page types: home, catalog, product, cart, checkout, account, search, content, blog-index, blog-article, faq, contact, legal and not-found.
Home is intentionally minimal: shared header, one editable starter/placeholder section and shared footer.
Catalog, product, search, cart and checkout contain the minimum canonical commerce components needed to remain operational rather than becoming decorative placeholders.
All pages use the existing Page Schema, component registry, responsive authority and Builder; no Blank-specific renderer or editor is introduced.
Blank Studio global design tokens are neutral and editable; engine/capability colors inherit those tokens unless explicitly overridden by the shared engineStyle contract.
The package ships no fake products or category-specific demo catalog by default.
Shared engines such as Shop the Look / Interactive Scene remain available through capability/entitlement and Library composition, not hard-coded into Blank Studio.
A neutral cookie-consent preset exists for the system template.
Template library UX clearly labels Blank Studio as a system/blank starting point rather than one of the curated visual designs.
Blank Studio owns an explicit Template Factory quality candidate manifest with canonical 14x3 coverage; the system-template distinction must not bypass normal browser/structural proof.
invariants: Curated launchTarget remains 42 and STOREFRONT_TEMPLATE_PORTFOLIO_STATUS.implemented counts only curated design templates.
Blank Studio uses one canonical runtime and one canonical Page document authority.
No system template component bypasses capability or page-type validation.
No demo product is installed implicitly by Blank Studio.
Commerce truth remains in shared catalog/cart/checkout authorities.
Blank Studio visual neutrality does not mean functional emptiness.
Template DNA/global tokens remain the default style source for all inserted engines.
System-template status never exempts Blank Studio from Template Factory quality ownership.

alternatives.summary: Treat Blank Studio as the 43rd normal design template.
alternatives.reason: It is infrastructure/a creation surface, not a curated visual design and would distort the 42-template portfolio metric.

alternatives.summary: Register Blank Studio as a system template beside the curated catalog while using the same resolver, installer, preview and runtime.
alternatives.reason: Keeps one engine and one installation authority while preserving portfolio semantics.

alternatives.summary: Create a special blank-editor mode without a template package.
alternatives.reason: Would create a second page/runtime lifecycle and break canonical Template → Page Preset → Section Preset → Component authority.

specialistReviews.finding: System template must be selectable without joining the curated portfolio count.
specialistReviews.resolution: Separate system-template catalog feeds the common resolver/library but is excluded from curated status metrics.

specialistReviews.finding: A visually empty template can become functionally empty and break commerce preview/runtime expectations.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep minimal real catalog/product/cart/checkout components and only simplify visual composition.

specialistReviews.finding: Blank should feel intentionally empty, not unfinished.
specialistReviews.resolution: Neutral header + starter canvas + footer, explicit Blank Studio labeling and neutral tokens.

specialistReviews.finding: Blank must not become a capability bypass surface.
specialistReviews.resolution: Package uses normal manifest requirements, registry validation and entitlement-aware Builder insertion only.

challenge.scenario: Adding Blank Studio to STOREFRONT_TEMPLATE_CATALOG raises implemented count and appears as template #43.
challenge.resolution: Keep curated catalog unchanged; add a separate system-template catalog and merge only at resolver/library discovery surfaces.

challenge.finding: No insertion anchor/header/footer and poor first-run UX.
challenge.resolution: Ship header, one editable starter section and footer.

challenge.scenario: Cart and checkout are only headings/placeholders.
challenge.resolution: Use canonical commerce.cart-summary and commerce.checkout-summary bindings.

challenge.scenario: Product page omits shared product data components.
challenge.finding: Blank cannot support a functioning product journey.
challenge.resolution: Use canonical product gallery + product info + primary purchase CTA in the standard 12-column grid.

challenge.scenario: Blank gets a bespoke engine list or Shop-the-Look implementation.
challenge.resolution: Blank contains no optional engine by default; Builder capability registry supplies them later.

challenge.finding: Blank inherits an unrelated generic green preview palette.
challenge.resolution: Register neutral Blank Studio theme tokens in the shared preview-theme authority.

challenge.scenario: Blank template has no cookie preset.
challenge.finding: Shared storefront shell may fail its current consent contract.
challenge.resolution: Register a compact neutral system cookie preset.

challenge.scenario: Library treats Blank as a category design and recommends Pro styling claims.
challenge.resolution: Provide explicit system category metadata and copy explaining it is a from-scratch starting point; same Alap/Pro capability model remains.

proofPlan: Run Plan Before Code before creating the system-template package.
Test exact 14-page matrix, unique page types, neutral home shell and operational commerce page components.
Test curated portfolio count is unchanged while resolver and merchant library can see Blank Studio.
Test no demo products are present and cookie preset/theme are explicit.
Run route-integrity and template capability validation against the normal component registry.
Run incremental replay, typecheck and production build on exact head.
Run Template Factory Quality Gate as regression proof; no golden update is permitted.
Close only with exact-head Completion Truth Gate evidence.

requirements.requirement: Provide Blank Studio as a selectable/resolvable system template without increasing the curated 42-template portfolio count.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Curated launch/implemented metrics must not count Blank Studio as a normal design template.

requirements.requirement: Provide the full canonical 14-page matrix through the existing Page Schema/runtime/installation authorities.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No missing/duplicate page type or Blank-specific renderer/page authority.

requirements.requirement: Keep Blank visually minimal but commerce-operational on catalog, product, search, cart and checkout.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Commerce-critical pages cannot be decorative placeholders only.

requirements.requirement: Use explicit neutral editable Template DNA/theme and neutral consent presentation with no implicit demo catalog.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No category-specific fallback theme, missing cookie preset or automatic demo products.

requirements.requirement: Keep optional engines template-independent and available through normal capability-aware Builder composition.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No Shop-the-Look or other engine is hard-coded as a Blank-specific implementation.

notes: Blank Studio is a system creation surface beside the curated 42-template portfolio. It deliberately carries the minimum operational commerce shell and neutral DNA, while optional engines remain Library/capability-driven. No main merge and no golden update. Exact actual-diff reconciliation expanded the applicable known-failure envelope to the full 49/49 set for the same builder-template-system + shared-storefront scope. This updates machine-derived proof metadata only; acceptance criteria, forbidden states and implementation scope are unchanged. Template Factory correctly rejected the newly added template source until it owned an explicit quality manifest. Blank Studio is now registered as a candidate for canonical 14x3 structural/browser proof; no gate exemption or golden weakening was introduced. Header/footer identities were also normalized across all 14 documents so the canonical shell can be proven rather than special-cased.
